summary.content:
Today's selection covers 101 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 58 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: How a Niche Technology Became a Choke Point for A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Local Police Collusion Hampers Crackdown on Asian Scam Centers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
